title: Figure 18. Atlas IIAS Mode-5 Ship-Hit Contours with A = 3.45
description: Contour plot of "Crossrange Distance (nm)" versus "Downrange Distance (nm)" showing nested Mode-5 ship-hit probability contours at 10^-5 and 10^-6. In-plot labels read "Atlas IIAS," "Mode 5 P_I," and "B = 1,000, A = 3.45." The outer contour extends about 16 nm downrange.
